lines: She sways, fades, and sings, the oxygen‑starved girl on the verge of tears
She laments that there’s nothing amusing at all
Absurdity beckons
Everyone looks the same, a little unsettling
Vulgar chatter, trivial information, spat out
A pointless fight just to claim distinction
Even saying the truth feels like it could kill us
We have to put even the things we don’t want to say into words
We laugh, thinking how absurd it all is
She sways, fades, and sings, the oxygen‑starved girl on the verge of tears
What happens if I die? asks the dreamy oxygen‑starved girl
She kept lamenting that there’s nothing amusing at all
A great calamity invades daily life, and we forget how to breathe
Just facing the harsh reality exhausts us completely
Even the people we cherish drift away, leaving us lonely and aching
Even if we think of it, our wishes won’t reach
What do you love, what do you hate? asks the vague oxygen‑starved girl
Stay by my side forever
Don’t leave me alone
She sways, fades, and sings, the oxygen‑starved girl on the verge of tears
What happens if I die? asks the dreamy oxygen‑starved girl
